findings.rule: AC-001 / FR-001 / D-03 total lifecycle budget
findings.evidence: run_owned disarms ITIMER_REAL on timeout and returns into _capture_execution, which still calls _manifests and _finish_capture/_publish. A short real child sleeping 1s with timeout=0.15 plus an in-memory 0.4s delay in the second _manifests call returned exit124 after0.567s (budget.elapsed_seconds0.5655). The post-timeout finalization has no active watchdog. timeout_capture after a preparation alarm likewise executes after the one-shot alarm was consumed. Unsuccessful certification does not satisfy the promised finite total command bound.
findings.correction: Keep finalization inside an absolute bounded envelope after child termination; ensure both normal timeout finalization and preparation-timeout publication cannot perform unbounded manifests/storage work. Add only a targeted regression for this demonstrated path.

findings.evidence: granularity is set to individual-and-command before _prepare_cargo succeeds. Both capture and prepare_uncaptured catch CargoRunnerUnavailable and execute raw Cargo, retaining that granularity. In-memory unavailable-toolchain reproduction returned argv [cargo,test] with scope.evidence.enforcement individual-and-command. Individual guards were not installed.
findings.correction: Set individual-and-command only after successful preparation, or explicitly restore command-only on fallback in both captured and uncaptured paths.
